keemun
Paris, France167 contributions

Fabulous
Aug 2026 • Couples
A treat! Contemporary and elegant setting, impeccable and attentive service, Zao probably embodies a new generation of Vietnamese chefs by intelligently and delicately blending tradition and modernity. The cuisine is inventive, flavorful, and exciting: Hue-style foie gras and eel dumplings, perfectly cooked aged duck with a delicious sauce, divine lemon and basil tart. A slight error in the kitchen was made up for with kindness and commitment, making our evening a moment of pleasure and deep satisfaction.

Really good place
Jun 2026 • Friends
My friends and I have been here many times, and every visit has been a genuinely enjoyable experience.
This isn't the kind of place that immediately blows you away with a big "wow" factor. Instead, it offers something much more special — a warm, cozy atmosphere that feels familiar and comforting. It's the kind of place that quietly makes you want to come back again and again.
The food is delicious, and each dish has its own unique touch that makes it memorable. 
The drinks are also well-balanced and easy to enjoy.
What really stands out, though, is the staff. They're incredibly friendly, kind, and welcoming. Every time I visit, I get the feeling that they're always nearby and ready to help whenever I need anything. Their genuine hospitality makes the whole experience even better.
